description: The line plot illustrates the harmfulness ratio across different model configurations and datasets, with the x-axis representing the model size in terms of parameters (128, 256, 512, 1024) and the y-axis showing the harmful with refusal ratio on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot includes four distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model and dataset combination: LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds). The LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep line starts at approximately 0.21 and increases to 0.37, while the Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep line begins at 0.16 and rises to 0.43. The LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench line starts at 0.08 and increases to 0.39, and the Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench line starts at 0.26 and increases to 0.52. All lines show a general upward trend as the model size increases, with the Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench line consistently having the highest harmful with refusal ratio across all model sizes.
